d: An intensive manhunt has been launched across Tamil Nadu and along border checkposts after 17 remand prisoners escaped from a sub-jail in Theni district. The inmates reportedly feigned a medical condition to lure wardens into their cell, violently assaulted three prison personnel, and fled the premises. Senior police officials, including the Director General of Police and Inspector General, are inspecting the facility to probe potential security lapses, while four escapees have been apprehended so far.
